    <title>v16.4.0-canary.35</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Misc Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>Nudge the agents for future defaults adoption: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5473362356" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98721" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98721/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98721">#98721</a></li>

<li>Nudge the agents for latest version upgrade: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5449610378" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98640" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98640/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98640">#98640</a></li>
<li>Add "latest" upgrade coverage for <code>next upgrade --ai</code>: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5448164180" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98633" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98633/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98633">#98633</a></li>

<li>Add <code>next upgrade --ai</code> and security vulnerability coverage: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5424814467" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98562" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98562/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98562">#98562</a></li>

<ul>

<li>next/image: Reject empty images when reading/writing to the disk cache (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5325933319" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98186" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98186/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98186">#98186</a>)</li>
<li>Emit whole-app server NFTs when <code>output: 'standalone'</code> is used with an adapter (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5321818276" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98167" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98167/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98167">#98167</a>)</li>
<li>Add CSP nonce to script tags of loading and template files (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5396867257" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98403" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98403/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98403">#98403</a>)</li>
<li>Fix <code>use cache</code> prerender signal retention (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5404486551" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/98448" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vercel/next.js/pull/98448/hovercard" href="https://github.com/vercel/next.js/pull/98448">#98448</a>)</li>
